name: Graphify
cost: Free to run locally. Graphify Cloud is a paid layer with a 14-day free trial
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and 20+ more
short: Maps your codebase, docs and PDFs into a knowledge graph your coding agent can query instead of grepping through files.
what: You type `/graphify .` in your coding agent and it maps the project into a graph. Code is parsed locally with tree-sitter across about 40 languages, with no LLM. Docs, PDFs and images get a semantic pass from your agent's model or an API key you set. You get an HTML graph to click through, a `GRAPH_REPORT.md` with the key concepts, and a `graph.json` you can query with `graphify query`, `graphify path` and `graphify explain`. Each edge is tagged as read from the source or inferred.
who: Developers who work in large or unfamiliar codebases with a coding agent. A small project you already know well won't gain much.

steps.title: Install the CLI
steps.text: The PyPI package is `graphifyy` with two y's. The README says other `graphify` packages on PyPI are not theirs. `pipx install graphifyy` also works.

steps.title: Register the skill
steps.text: This detects your assistant. For another one, add a platform, for example `graphify install --platform codex`. Add `--project` to install into the current repository instead.

steps.title: Build the graph
steps.text: Run this in your coding agent. In Codex, use `$graphify` instead. The output goes to `graphify-out/`.

steps.title: Query it
steps.code: /graphify query "what connects auth to the database?"

steps.title: Make your agent use it every time (optional)
steps.text: This writes a hook or instruction file that tells your agent to check the graph before searching files.

watch: Code stays on your machine, but docs, PDFs and images are sent to your agent's model or to the API backend you configure. Use `--code-only` to skip them.
Every query is logged to `~/.cache/graphify-queries.log`. Set `GRAPHIFY_QUERY_LOG_DISABLE=1` to opt out.
The always-on setup writes hooks or instruction files such as `AGENTS.md` into your project.
Codex needs `multi_agent = true` under `[features]` in `~/.codex/config.toml` for parallel extraction.
The README promotes Graphify Cloud, a paid service. You don't need it for the local tool.
